Overview

Pisa is a city in Tuscany with a population of 90,000. Home to the iconic Leaning Tower, a historic Tuscan city with a prestigious university and a lively student atmosphere. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
